prompts.concept: Use case: illustration-story. Develop ONE coherent keyframe concept of an intimate handmade print puzzle box on a warm wood desk, 1536x1024. This is concept art for a playable independent birthday game, not a web UI. Reference 1 is the PRIMARY established game painting: precise soft pencil outlines, calm ivory/sage/honey wood, restrained watercolor grain, natural diffused morning light. Reference 2 gives accepted fine paper treatment. Preserve this language, do not shift into glossy3D, realism, high fantasy, heavy sepia, photoreal textures or ornate AI ornament. View almost straight down with just enough lower-front depth to read the little drawer. Compose the complete main wooden apparatus in the RIGHT TWO THIRDS with generous margins: a compact honey-wood rectangular handcraft print box, with three EMPTY rectangular cassette wells side by side on its upper bed. The three wells are identical in size and aligned left to right, clear edges and enough room to hold independently moving wood plates. At the right outer edge is a slender brass vertical press mechanism and ONE short wood grip, credible hinges and no extraneous knobs; its moving handle is clearly separate from the bed. At the lower-front edge is one small CLOSED shallow drawer with a restrained brass pull. A plain thin wooden SLIDING LID of matching width has been slid backward/up on two simple rails, exposing the cassette wells; the lid remains above the apparatus, with a large EMPTY ivory label strip where five printed symbols will later be added in code. No drawn glyphs on that label. On the LEFT THIRD, three separate COMPLETE narrow cream test papers lie casually but legibly one above another, each blank with generous empty centers; tiny natural creases and faint contact shadows, no decorative pictures or borders to confuse clues. There is one additional blank output paper partly under the front of the press box, in an obvious receiving tray. The wood desk itself is simple and gently textured, a small corner of unpatterned cream linen underneath the box. Everything feels like the same little object that could sit on the reference desk, not an industrial machine. Physical joints, rail locations and the paper feed should make visual sense; no floating parts. No text, letters, numbers, interface panels, arrows, captions, motif clues, characters, extra books, flowers, screens, fake gears, watermark or vignette. Leave clean enough spaces that native game ink can be printed on the papers without covering artwork.
prompts.main: Use case: illustration-story, transparent game sprite atlas. Input1 is the accepted KEYFRAME CONCEPT of the handmade print puzzle box; input2 is the primary established game room linework/light. Create matching separated mechanical parts, NOT another whole scene. Transparent1536x1024 canvas, no background, clear gaps and safe complete edges. THREE objects: A in LEFT 980x1024 area: the complete honey-wood MAIN BODY from input1, same near-top-down slight front-depth viewpoint and fine pale pencil/watercolor material. Three EMPTY cassette wells side by side, plain dark inner bottoms, equal dimensions. Keep two short top sliding-lid tracks but NO lid or ivory label board fixed above the body. At right edge retain the fixed brass press column/base but remove its ENTIRE moving lever and wood grip: leave a simple small pivot socket. Lower-front drawer location is an EMPTY dark shallow mouth with no drawer front, no handle, no paper. Leave a tiny unobtrusive flat mounting dot by the lower-left lip for a separately animated latch. No loose cards, cassettes, glyphs, gears, duplicate controls or shadows of removed parts. Full solid outer case with its thin front depth and subtle contact shadow, no crop. B in UPPER RIGHT536x550 area: ONLY the matching complete wooden sliding LID, landscape approximately500x270, same viewpoint, clean full edge, restrained empty ivory rectangular label taking most of its center. Its actual long front-to-back dimension must fit the full three-well bed when placed on it; no fixed rails or press body behind it. C in LOWER RIGHT536x474 area: ONLY the matching open shallow DRAWER, complete landscape wood tray with its front face and one small brass pull; empty interior, the same honey wood/pencil details and viewpoint. This drawer will slide out of the main body's mouth. Keep components physically consistent in proportions and lighting, accurate straight rails and joints, quiet handmade game aesthetic, no glossy3D/product photography, oversaturated orange, thick black outlines or random ornate decoration. No text, numbers, arrows, simulated clues, cards, characters, scenery, watermark. True alpha outside all three objects; never join them together.
